name: Network Neuro Aggregator
summary: Aggregates density and count connectivity matrices from several networkneuro outputs into mean and standard-deviation matrices, shown as heatmaps.
description: Reads density.csv and count.csv from each input, computes the element-wise mean and standard deviation with numpy, writes density/count mean and std CSV files, and adds plotly heatmaps to the job's product. It registers no output datatype; the CSVs stay in the job's working directory.

inputs.description: Several networkneuro outputs; each must contain density.csv and count.csv.
inputs.requirements: All matrices must have the same size (same parcellation).
